title: Aureline M5 canonical-source relation
description: Canonical per-domain source relation for a generated or projection object. Names the object class, its owning-source association, the canonical source or backing object, whether the object has diverged from that source, and the regenerate / detach relation that keeps derived truth joined to its source — so a generated artifact or virtual projection never silently overwrites, or masquerades as, its canonical source. Downstream editor banners, diff / review headers, write-review sheets, AI / automation paths, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a class's canonical-source relation by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
